title: Aman Kaushik's engineering focus
content: Aman Kaushik is an AI/ML and full-stack engineer whose work combines AI/ML, full-stack development, and Android engineering. He is especially interested in practical applications built with Python, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), large language models, and modern user interfaces.

title: Current location
content: Aman Kaushik is based in Bangalore, India.

title: Hometown
content: Aman Kaushik is from Muzaffarpur, Bihar.

title: Professional opportunities
content: Aman Kaushik is available for AI/ML, Python, and full-stack opportunities and is open to relevant engineering opportunities.

title: Working approach
content: Aman describes his approach as transforming ideas into working products through AI-first problem solving, complete product development, web and Android experience, and continuous learning and adaptability. His workflow is presented as Ideas, Context, Intelligence, and Experience.

title: Interest in poetry and technology
content: Beyond engineering, Aman created Poetic Pebbles to provide a thoughtful publishing and sharing experience for poetry lovers. He describes the project as bringing together poetry, technology, and scale.
